data.subTitle: Full-Stack & AI/GenAI Developer specializing in real-time collaborative applications, intelligent data pipelines, and LLM streaming solutions.
aboutDescription: Hello! I'm Siddharth Shukla, a Full-Stack and AI/GenAI Developer based in Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, India.
Currently pursuing my B.Tech in Information Technology at ABES Engineering College, Ghaziabad (2023–2027) with a CGPA of 8.25/10.

I specialize in building scalable web architectures, real-time collaboration platforms with WebSockets/Socket.io, intelligent transaction pipelines with FastAPI & Celery, and LLM-powered applications using Google Gemini API.
Beyond core software engineering, I am an active Core Team Member at Google Developer Group (GDG), co-leading national hackathons, coordinating technical workshops, and mentoring tech enthusiasts.

projects.description: A high-performance real-time collaborative code editor with AI-powered code review and explanation features.
highlights: Supports 10+ concurrent users using Socket.io WebSockets with room-isolated sessions.
Reduced sync latency below 100ms through event-payload optimization.
MongoDB persistence enables code recovery on session rejoin.
Added Gemini-powered AI Code Review and Explain features.
Express backend streams AI output token-by-token using SSE.

projects.description: An asynchronous AI transaction processing pipeline for cleaning, anomaly detection, and LLM classification.
highlights: Async pipeline processing financial CSVs through cleaning, anomaly detection, LLM classification and summarization.
Idempotent tasks prevent duplicate processing on retries.
Batched LLM classification with fault-tolerant persistence.
React dashboard for live transaction-processing status.

projects.description: An intelligent AI platform generating company-specific interview sessions and automated scoring.
highlights: Generates 50 company-specific interview questions per session.
Gemini-based evaluation provides feedback, scores and improvement suggestions.
REST API + MongoDB for interview history and analytics.

projects.description: IoT-enabled smart irrigation system optimizing agricultural water usage using predictive machine learning.
highlights: ESP32 irrigation system using soil moisture, humidity, rainfall and water-level sensors.
Real-time monitoring and automated pump control.
Predictive scheduling model reduced measured water usage by 30%.
Node.js REST API dashboard with alerts and historical visualization.

bullets: Co-led HackHaven 2.0, a 24-hour national hackathon with 200+ participants, 50+ teams and colleges.
Secured 5 of 30+ sponsors through outreach and negotiation.
Coordinated 20+ core team members across logistics, judging and technical workshops.

data.contactParagraph: I am currently open to exciting full-time roles, internships, and project collaborations. Feel free to get in touch!
